- Each module’s `Cargo.toml` with correct `[[bin]]` for `cli`/`web` and `dev-dependencies` (`test-utils`, `mockito`, etc.)
- Minimal runtime tests (e.g., `cli --help`, `web` server start) in `tests/` dir
- All files labeled `Created by EXCAVA` in comments
- Vet’s G-12 test report (proof of runtime validation)
